note: Live snacks_capabilities is authoritative. Owner-only actions cannot be invoked from Condiments.

actions.name: general-get
actions.description: Read app-wide General settings and current window fullscreen state.

actions.name: general-sources
actions.description: Discover Example panel targets: Example is always first, then named Snack Bars, open Snacks, ChipClips and available previous sources.

actions.name: general-update
actions.description: Persist app-wide UI, Preference and Experimental settings. All experiments default off.

actions.name: fullscreen-set
actions.description: Enter or exit responsive fullscreen for a Snack, also toggled by double-clicking its top or bottom bar. Requires the app-wide fullscreen experiment. No page zoom; restores original bounds and orientation. Pinned fullscreen has highest stacking priority.

actions.name: example-launch
actions.description: Launch or focus the configured Main Snack Example panel target.

actions.name: terminal-state
actions.description: Read whether Main Snack’s Pasta panel is showing its session-only hidden terminal.

actions.name: terminal-set
actions.description: Show or hide the hidden Main Snack terminal while preserving Main Pasta. Also reached by clicking the General header logo six times within six seconds.

actions.name: terminal-command
actions.description: Run a slash command using the same action registry and the caller’s current permissions. /help discovers commands; no OS shell or eval.

actions.name: terminal-sources
actions.description: List HTML sources and built-in UI parts editable in Pasta Studio.

actions.name: studio-open-part
actions.description: Open an independent editable copy of a built-in Snack UI in Pasta Studio. Includes CSS and inert host JavaScript source; never overwrites app files.

actions.name: configure
actions.description: Open or reuse the independent Serving Tray on SnackBars, select the requested slot and scroll to the top. Closing the bar keeps its tray alive.

actions.name: source-edit
actions.description: Read editable content from an open, saved or previous source key.

actions.name: update-history
actions.description: Update a previous Snack in history, retaining the source key used by its links.

actions.name: update-open
actions.description: Update an open Pasta/URL Snack or Main Snack draft.

actions.name: external-open
actions.description: Open an explicit HTTPS documentation or publisher link in the user’s browser; no credentials in URLs.

actions.name: tailscale-add
actions.description: Create or edit a persistent Snack Time desktop or individual source link; sourceKey desktop shares the monitor layout. Private by default.

actions.name: tailscale-access
actions.description: Create a Vault-stored access code scoped to one public tunnel or all public tunnels in a group. Never grants agent API access.

actions.name: tailscale-group-save
actions.description: Apply visibility and interaction settings to every tunnel in a named group. Private revokes all codes scoped to any affected tunnel.

actions.name: studio-clear
actions.description: Clear the specified Pasta document; Main Snack Pasta remains a permanent scratchpad.

actions.name: browser-state
actions.description: Read native website navigation, title, loading, history, zoom and renderer state.

actions.name: performance-status
actions.description: Measure current Snacks process CPU/memory, browser renderers, visibility and background policy. No page HTML or secrets.

actions.name: preview-saved
actions.description: Read a retained website preview for a saved Snack; refresh requests a new capture while keeping the last good snapshot on failure. Single queued renderer, bounded disk/memory cache; no running page in the preset.

actions.name: history-cleanup
actions.description: Remove closed, unreferenced Previous Snack snapshots. Preserve open windows, Pasta Studio documents and tunnel sources. Saved Snacks remain in their independent library.

actions.name: snackbar-list
actions.description: List persistent named Snack Bars, their independent preset slots and global ChipClips.

actions.name: snackbar-create
actions.description: Create and open a Snack Bar. Default name uses the lowest unused Snack Bar N, starting at 2.

actions.name: chipclip-unassign
actions.description: Move a ChipClip out of all Snack Bar preset slots into the global unassigned pool; keep its content.

actions.name: snackbar-place
actions.description: Move a ChipClip into a Snack Bar in the sidebar, or reorder it before slot. Maximum three; a full target rejects without moving the original.

actions.name: studio-state
actions.description: Read the shared Pasta Studio workspace, active HTML buffer, version, tabs, linked windows, conflicts and available sources.

actions.name: studio-open
actions.description: Open the Serving Tray-sized Pasta Studio for Main Snack, an HTML window, saved HTML or previous source; changes stay synchronized.

actions.name: studio-update
actions.description: Edit shared HTML. Supply revision for optimistic concurrency; a conflict preserves both buffers. force explicitly replaces the shared buffer.

actions.name: condiment-status
actions.description: Read the external-only Condiment Store, source catalogs and approved controls. Condiments never patch Snack’s installed code.

actions.name: condiment-source-add
actions.description: Add a public GitHub/Pages catalog, connected private GitHub or local folder Condiment source. Manifest: snack-condiments.json.

actions.name: condiment-source-choose
actions.description: Choose a local Condiment source folder using the native picker.

actions.name: condiment-approve
actions.description: Owner approval of requested Condiment grants; only requested areas/levels may be approved. Enables the reviewed version.

actions.name: condiment-open
actions.description: Open an enabled external Condiment in a sandboxed Serving Tray-sized Snack.

actions.name: condiment-command
actions.description: Invoke a third-party command declared by its manifest and served by its open sandboxed UI. Discover schemas in condiment-agent-guide. The caller must hold the module’s approved grants; all nested tools remain checked.

actions.name: condiment-storage-get
actions.description: Read/write a Condiment-owned JSON setting in its private namespace. Modules cannot access another module’s storage. Keep credentials in Vault.

actions.name: condiment-storage-set
actions.description: Read/write a Condiment-owned JSON setting in its private namespace. Modules cannot access another module’s storage. Keep credentials in Vault.

actions.name: condiment-storage-remove
actions.description: Read/write a Condiment-owned JSON setting in its private namespace. Modules cannot access another module’s storage. Keep credentials in Vault.

actions.name: condiment-agent-guide
actions.description: Read an enabled Condiment’s optional onboarding and skills, approved permissions and current connector. Instructions do not grant permissions.

actions.name: condiment-invoke
actions.description: Invoke a current shared Snack action through a Condiment. Enforces the intersection of its approved grants and the caller’s current grants. Cannot access managed secrets or owner-only actions.

actions.name: media-begin
actions.description: Begin a managed attachment upload, up to 100 MB. No arbitrary local path access.

actions.name: presentation-state
actions.description: Read composable presentation layers for any Snack. Layers are provided by third-party Condiments; the host has no named customization types.

actions.name: presentation-set
actions.description: Set or remove a caller-owned CSS presentation layer on a Snack, using host/content rules and managed image references. Native APIs remain isolated.

actions.name: presentation-host-state
actions.description: Read compiled presentation CSS for the current trusted host.

actions.name: chat-agents
actions.description: List available OpenAI account agents and paired API/MCP inbox agents, with multiple global selections.

actions.name: chat-agent-add
actions.description: Add a named OpenAI model participant using the existing account connection.

actions.name: chat-list
actions.description: Read conversation summaries. Remote agents see only conversations they participate in.

actions.name: chat-send
actions.description: Send a human/agent message with shared files and a reply target. Sender identity is authenticated. OpenAI recipients run through the account runtime; paired clients receive API/MCP inbox messages.

actions.name: chat-inbox
actions.description: Read messages addressed to the authenticated agent, including shared-file metadata. Reply with chat-send to continue agent-to-agent or agent-to-human conversations.

actions.name: chat-file
actions.description: Read a 768 KiB base64 chunk of an attachment actually shared with this conversation. No host paths or credentials.

actions.name: chat-file-inspect
actions.description: Inspect a shared file. Extracts text, PDF text, Office XML and bounded ZIP contents; audio/video remain shared files for capable receiving agents.

actions.name: chat-share-guides
actions.description: Add enabled Condiment onboarding and skills to a conversation as optional guidance.

actions.name: email-status
actions.description: Read Email connector providers, mailboxes, current access and command receipts. No secrets.

actions.name: email-connect
actions.description: Connect Gmail, Microsoft, Zoho through browser authorization, or an IMAP/SMTP mailbox. Credentials stay in Vault.

actions.name: email-update
actions.description: Pause a mailbox or change approved senders and email-command access areas. Owner only.

actions.name: email-disconnect
actions.description: Disconnect a mailbox and revoke its local command code.

actions.name: email-copy-instructions
actions.description: Copy private mailbox command instructions to clipboard without returning the command code.

actions.name: email-test
actions.description: Send a self-addressed awareness test command through this mailbox. It requests an actual receipt and result; it does not change permissions.

actions.name: email-check
actions.description: Check connected mailboxes and retry pending receipt/result emails. Does not rerun completed actions.
